claim: ChatGPT got me out of a £100 parking ticket - Reddit
summary: A few days ago, I received a parking ticket for a violation that I admittedly committed. However, I decided to appeal the fine, hoping for a stroke of luck or a sympathetic ear. I asked ChatGPT to write an appeal for me, knowing I had no excuse to give.
